Lamb
Although representing a smaller portion of overall muscle food consumption, lamb still provides a nutrient proﬁle with signiﬁcant
beneﬁts for the human diet. As a source of high-quality protein, lamb is also a good source of many minerals and B-vitamins.
Vitamin B12 is especially abundant in lamb. It is also a good source of the minerals iron and zinc.
